items.summary:

The national carrier is boosting the speed of its first hydrogen train, which currently operates on the 89 km Jind-Sonipat route, following successful 120 kmph trials. This initiative represents a core part of the move toward zero-emission transport across the network, with new CCTV integrations enhancing passenger security.

Beyond hydrogen technology, the update covers the broader rail infrastructure roadmap, including the rollout of 11 additional Vande Bharat sleeper trains. items.title: Orchestration & Agent Harness: How AI Systems Are Coordinated
items.summary:
Most AI systems are not one model doing everything. They are several components working together, and something has to keep them in sync.

Think of an insurance claim: one component extracts information from documents, another checks it against policy rules, another routes the case to the right team. Orchestration is the logic that decides which does what, in what order, and what gets passed between them.

Terms covered:
- Orchestration: the coordination layer across components
- Agent Orchestration: orchestration applied to autonomous agents handing off work
- Agent Runtime: the execution environment where agents actually operate
- Agent Harness: the framework connecting agents, tools, memory and instructions into one system

This is how AI goes from a single smart response to a coordinated system handling complex, multi-step work at scale.

—

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: The Indian Who Sold Two IT Companies Is Now Trying to Fix India's Education Crisis
items.summary:
In 1977, Raj Vattikuti began his technology career as an MIS project leader at Chrysler working on mainframes. He went on to found Covansys (Complete Business Solutions), an IT services pioneer acquired by Computer Sciences Corporation (CSC) for $1.3 billion, before building Altimetrik and now leading Calibo as Founder and Executive Chairman. Spanning nearly 50 years across four distinct technology eras, from mainframe computing and offshore IT services to cloud platforms and generative AI, Vattikuti’s career offers a unique vantage point on the evolving relationship between technical education and enterprise employability.

In this episode of Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Raj Vattikuti, Founder & Executive Chairman of Calibo, to explore how AI is fundamentally redefining career readiness for young engineers. They discuss Calibo’s business-first AI innovation sandboxes, partnering with the Andhra Pradesh government to train 100,000 students annually, moving beyond passive prompt consumerism to business-outcome engineering, replacing legacy IT transformation jargon with simplified data products, and advice for parents navigating tech sector shifts.

Is the traditional link between a college degree and a tech career permanently breaking in the AI era?

items.title: HOW TO STOP AN AI
items.summary:
You cannot force a highly excited dynamical system into its ground state simply by redefining its boundary conditions. Yet, this is exactly what we have been trying to do with Large Reasoning Models.

When early-exit algorithms inject a /think token to truncate a model's computational chain, the autoregressive engine ignores the artificial boundary. Instead of collapsing into a final answer state, the model exhibits spurious CoT termination. 

It smuggles its incomplete reasoning trajectory into the observable output space (perfectly conserving its truncated compute momentum) until it spontaneously emits a second /think token.

But what happens when we force the AI model to stop thinking? 
Watch my latest video to dive into the attention matrices and see exactly why structural syntax fails to govern internal state dynamics.

All rights w/ authors:
"/think Doesn’t Stop Reasoning: Analysis of Spurious CoT Termination"
Seunghee Koh Sungjae Choi Minchan Kwon Sunghyun Baek Junmo Kim
from
Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, South Korea

items.title: HUGE: Google DeepMind Chose 4 Indian Teams to Solve Climate Problems With AI
items.summary:
Google DeepMind has launched AI for the Planet, selecting 16 APAC teams, including four from India, to tackle climate change.

Google DeepMind has launched the AI for the Planet initiative, a program designed to foster innovation across the Asia-Pacific region. Sixteen organizations have been selected to participate in a three-month program, where they will leverage advanced technology to address pressing environmental challenges.

Four of the selected teams are based in India, focusing their efforts on critical areas such as biodiversity, agriculture, climate, and carbon solutions. By providing these organizations with resources to build environmental AI, the program aims to accelerate the development of practical applications that can have a measurable impact on sustainability efforts across the region. This initiative offers a window into how APAC startups are applying machine learning to solve real-world ecological problems.

items.title: Inside Big Tech's 3-Week Problem
items.summary: In episode 1023 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Aishwarya Srinivasan, Co-Founder of The Gen Academy about contrasting AI adoption between startups and large enterprises, highlighting startups' speed of execution and openness to 'messy building' versus enterprises' hierarchy and red tape. She explains that startups' willingness to launch products quickly and iterate openly gives them a significant execution advantage. Aishwarya notes that many large tech companies are now trying to adopt this agile, less hierarchical mindset to stay competitive in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

items.title: EXPOSED: Spotify Cut Its Claude AI Bill by 90 Percent and Did Not Even Switch Models
items.summary:
Spotify reduced its Claude token usage by 90 percent. See how the company routed coding agent tasks to cheaper models.

Spotify is optimizing its Spotify AI infrastructure by shifting specific coding agent tasks away from expensive frontier models. This strategy recognizes that not every automated development task requires the most advanced capabilities, allowing for significant efficiency gains.

By leveraging its internal developer platform, Portal, the team successfully managed their Claude token usage while maintaining output standards. This approach highlights a growing trend in enterprise tech where organizations balance performance with effective AI cost optimization strategies.

items.title: BREAKING: Jensen Huang Says AGI Is Here But the Scientific Community Says Not So Fast
items.summary:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang claims AGI has arrived. We analyze this declaration alongside OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra model and its impact.

The global conversation surrounding artificial general intelligence is intensifying. While NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang asserts that AGI has arrived, citing significant advancements in AI scaling, the broader research community remains divided. This debate stems largely from the lack of a universal definition for what constitutes true general intelligence in machines.

We break down the technical implications of GPT-6 Astra and how recent GPU deployment is accelerating these developments. This analysis is designed for decision-makers tracking the rapid evolution of foundational models and the infrastructure powering them. We examine whether these milestones represent a genuine shift or remain subject to ongoing technical scrutiny.
